note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Emerson 1960 (American Museum Novitates No. 1988, 'New Termitinae from the Ethiopian Region'); the original is in English; the queen is described in the morphotype and comparison paragraphs, the beginning of the source pack (the queen measurement table and the first half of the description) being truncated, so only the readable characters of the queen are given and no measurements are supplied. Soldier measurements are taken from table 8 of that paper. The source pack continues from line 114 with the next species, Furculitermes cubitalis, which was not used.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier closely related to F. winifredae, distinguished from it by the labrum: median lobe of the labrum shorter, lateral lobes long and moderately slender, lateral margins distinctly curved. Upper margin of the head slightly convex in lateral view, with a shallow concavity behind the frontal projection; antennae 14 or 15-segmented; outer margin of the mandibles more evenly curved. Queen: pronotum distinctly longer than half its width; posterior margin of the mesonotum with a notch angle slightly greater than a right angle, that of the metanotum equal to a right angle.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Close to the soldier of F. winifredae, differing in the labrum: median lobe of the labrum shorter, lateral lobes long and moderately slender, lateral margins markedly curved. Upper margin of the head slightly convex in lateral view, slightly concave behind the frontal projection. Antennae 14 or 15-segmented. Outer margin of the mandibles more evenly curved. Measurements (mm; holotype, paratype range in parentheses): head length with mandibles 3.79 (to 3.94); head length to mandible base 2.03 (1.88—2.00); head length to tip of frontal projection 1.90 (1.76—1.88); head width 1.76 (1.68—1.76); head thickness (including postmentum) 1.36 (1.32—1.38); median length of postmentum 0.94 (0.89—0.91); maximum width of postmentum 0.43 (0.44—0.47); minimum width of postmentum 0.32 (0.33—0.39); median length of labrum 0.21 (0.12—0.18); length of labral lateral lobe from the base 1.03 (0.94—1.00); length of left mandible 2.14 (2.07—2.20); length of left mandible from the tooth to the apex 1.25 (1.20—1.24); pronotum length 0.41 (0.42), width 0.90 (0.88); hind tibia length 1.41 (1.35—1.46). Supplementary measurements of the paratype colony: head length to mandible base 1.91, head width 1.72, maximum width of postmentum 0.45, minimum width of postmentum 0.30, median length of labrum 0.18, length of labral lateral lobe 0.97, length of left mandible 2.12, length of left mandible from the tooth to the apex 1.21, pronotum length 0.46, width 0.90, hind tibia length 1.43.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen (morphotype): distance between the ocellus and the compound eye slightly greater than the width of the ocellus itself; pronotum distinctly longer than half its width; posterior margin of the mesonotum with a notch angle slightly greater than a right angle, that of the metanotum equal to a right angle. Compared with the queen of F. winifredae, this species is larger in all measurements and darker, with the T-shaped mark on the pronotum lighter and indistinct.
